title: Remove System UI font stack
impact: Opinion request (revert #182), 3 +1/1 -1, two +1 comments. The stack is only injected when a target lacks system-ui. BUT found during triage: browserslist `defaults` with an outdated caniuse-lite db (very common) yields android 131, and compat.rs treats Android WebView < 150 as lacking system-ui, so many default-target users (e.g. Tailwind preflight `ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif`) get the stack. That likely explains why people still see it in 2024-2026.
code: scripts/build-prefixes.js: cssFeatures loop (caniuse min 'y' version per browser)
summary: Lightning CSS appends a platform font stack after system-ui only for targets without system-ui support (Chrome<56, Firefox<92, Safari<11, IE ...), mirroring postcss-preset-env; the maintainer replied in 2023 that it is a harmless fallback. Keep as designed. Separately, the Android threshold is wrong: caniuse collapses Android WebView to only the current version, so build-prefixes.js records the first supported version as whatever was current at generation (150 now; MDN says WebView 56). This affects ~21 caniuse-sourced features (nesting, :is/:not lists, system-ui...), not just this one.
repro: 568-repro.mjs: `.a{font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}`. No targets / chrome 120: unchanged (correct). chrome 50: stack added (intended). android 131: stack added on master, 1.33.0, 1.30.2 (wrong per MDN webview_android 56); correct in 1.25.0 because the threshold moves with each compat update.
evidence: repro.mjs local,1.33.0,1.30.2,1.25.0. browserslistToTargets(browserslist('defaults')) with repo's browserslist (caniuse-lite 1.0.30001690) -> android 131, the only target that triggers the stack. caniuse-lite 1.0.30001806 font-family-system-ui stats.android: only '150':'y', all 2.x-4.4 'n'. MDN css.types.font-family.system-ui webview_android version_added 56. Same android:131 target also lowers `&:hover` nesting and `:not(.b,.c)`. Related: #1180 (closed) / #1198 fixed only #rrggbbaa by switching that feature to MDN; its body notes other features still affected.

fix.approach: For #568 itself: none (keep), or close with reply. For the Android data bug: in scripts/build-prefixes.js, map caniuse `android` support to the and_chr/chrome version (or take webview_android from MDN) for the cssFeatures list, then regenerate compat.rs; never hand-edit compat.rs.

subcases.cause: scripts/build-prefixes.js takes min 'y' from caniuse stats.android, which only lists the current version

draftReply:
Thanks for the discussion! The fallback stack is only added when your targets include a browser without `system-ui` support (for example Chrome < 56, Firefox < 92, Safari < 11), the same approach as postcss-preset-env. With modern or no targets, `system-ui` is left alone. The data comes from caniuse and MDN: https://caniuse.com/font-family-system-ui.

While looking into this, we found that Android WebView versions older than the one current when our compat data was last updated are wrongly treated as unsupported. So browserslist `defaults` with an outdated browserslist database can trigger the stack. Running `npx update-browserslist-db@latest` avoids it for now, and we're looking at fixing the data. If you still see the stack with up-to-date targets, could you share your browserslist query?
